notes: REF-BM-02: fetchPageDetails/extractMetadata collect only title and description; favicon and preview image never collected. REF-BM-04: title/description/tags/note editable but URL cannot be edited (update() omits url; edit dialog shows address as static text). REF-BM-05: no DELETE endpoint or UI. REF-BM-07: cards show title/description/tags/domain but no favicon (uses a first-letter site-mark instead). REF-BM-14: search is a plain substring match over title/description/note/url with no #tag syntax (labels aren't even in the searched fields). REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase handling. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-22: list is always ordered created_at DESC; no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: notes are WYSIWYG rich-text HTML (contenteditable/execCommand, stored/rendered as sanitized HTML), not markdown. REF-BM-24/25: no page snapshot or PDF handling or Internet Archive support. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag anywhere. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: no user/display settings (sort, items per page, font size).
